chunks: And it is narrated from Mismāʿ Kardīn that he said:
I prayed with Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام for forty mornings. When he finished, he would raise his hands toward the sky and say:

We have entered the morning, and the dominion belongs to Allah. O Allah, we are Your servants and the children of Your servants. O Allah, protect us from where we guard ourselves and from where we do not guard ourselves. O Allah, watch over us from where we take precautions and from where we do not take precautions. O Allah, conceal us from where we seek concealment and from where we do not seek concealment. O Allah, cover us with sufficiency and wellbeing. O Allah, grant us wellbeing, and the continuity of wellbeing, and grant us gratitude for wellbeing.

key_terms.عَبِيدُكَ: Your servants in complete dependence upon You

ai.seo_question: What morning supplication did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام recite after prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith transmits a morning supplication recited by Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام after prayer. It expresses servitude to Allah, seeks divine protection in seen and unseen ways, and asks for sufficiency, wellbeing, and gratitude for that wellbeing.
